display_name: Roll back a self-deploy during the observation window
description: Operator-triggered abort. Callable only between cutover (step 6 of deploy_self) and teardown (step 9 inside complete_deploy). Verifies the old target group still exists, atomically modifies the listener rule back to it, and the running complete_deploy on the new color detects the rule change and exits status='cancelled' without tearing down the old service. Returns status='rollback_not_applicable' if called before cutover or after the old service is gone.
embedding_description: Roll back a self-deploy during the observation window. Aborts the deploy_self in flight. Operator triggers from a second MCP client when the new color misbehaves (high error rate, broken connector). Modifies the listener rule back to the previous version's target group; the running complete_deploy detects this and exits cancelled. Cannot reverse a fully torn-down deploy.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Status, version labels moved between, and finisher_cancelled flag.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: If status='rolled_back', name the rolled_back_from → rolled_back_to versions and confirm finisher_cancelled. If status='rollback_not_applicable', explain why (before cutover or after teardown).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Modifying the ALB listener rule back to the previous version during the observation window.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: no_listener_rule_for_solet: provisioning was incomplete or the ALB has been modified externally. The rollback verb cannot recover from missing AWS state.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm via AWS Console that both the current and prior target groups still exist; if the prior is already gone, the deploy passed the observation window and rollback is no longer possible — operator must run a fresh deploy_self with the old image tag.
